rationale: Build on the staged reverse-tail recurrence winner by keeping reverse recurrent updates intact while delaying and softening the anchor carry path. The recent anchor-refresh variants lost, so this run tests a narrower curriculum transplant: recurrent block updates can ramp as before, but carry mixing starts later, uses a lower floor, and stages more slowly. That should preserve the strong recurrent-tail family early, then spend late training adapting the anchor bridge only when the tail blocks are already useful, with no extra runtime shape churn and no export-path changes.
title: Decoupled Tail Carry Curriculum
